name: Rose Bouquet, Blush Pink
description: A delicate bouquet of handmade crochet roses in soft blush pink. Each petal is carefully shaped and stitched by hand, creating flowers that capture the romance of real roses without ever wilting. Perfect as a lasting gift or an elegant centerpiece for your home.

name: Sunflower Single Stem
description: A cheerful handmade crochet sunflower on a sturdy wire stem. The golden-yellow petals radiate warmth and happiness, making it the perfect pick-me-up for any room. Each sunflower is individually crafted with attention to every petal.

name: Tulip Trio, Spring Mix
description: A set of three handmade crochet tulips in soft spring colors, blush pink, butter yellow, and lavender. Arranged together, they bring the freshness of a spring garden into your space all year round.

name: Birthday Gift Box, Floral
description: A curated gift box with a handmade crochet flower, a hand-poured soy candle, a handwritten greeting card, and a dried flower sachet. Wrapped in tissue and presented in a kraft box with a satin ribbon. Ready to gift, no wrapping needed.

name: Lavender Fields, Watercolor Print
description: A serene watercolor painting of lavender fields at golden hour. The soft purples and warm golds create a calming atmosphere that transforms any wall into a window to the French countryside. Printed on premium archival paper with museum-grade inks.

name: Golden Hour, Abstract Acrylic
description: An original abstract acrylic painting in warm golds, burnt sienna, and cream. Textured brushstrokes catch the light differently throughout the day, giving this piece a living quality. Each painting is one-of-a-kind, no two are exactly alike.

name: Botanical Line Art, Monstera
description: A minimal botanical line drawing of a Monstera leaf, hand-drawn with fine-tip ink. Clean lines and open space make this print a versatile piece that complements any interior style, from modern minimalist to cozy boho.

name: Crochet Coaster Set, Earth Tones
description: A set of 4 handmade crochet coasters in warm earth tones, terracotta, olive, mustard, and cream. Machine washable and beautifully functional. Protects your surfaces while adding handmade charm to your coffee table.

name: Macrame Wall Hanging, Ivory
description: A handknotted macrame wall hanging in natural ivory cotton rope. Features a combination of square knots and spiral patterns that create beautiful texture and movement. Hung from a natural driftwood dowel, it adds warmth and boho elegance to any wall.

name: Crochet Plant Hanger, Natural
description: A sturdy yet delicate crochet plant hanger in natural off-white. Designed to hold pots up to 15cm in diameter. The open-weave pattern lets your plant breathe while adding a handmade touch to your indoor garden. Comes with a metal ceiling hook.
dimensions: 90cm long, fits pots up to 15cm diameter

name: Crochet Bead Bracelet, Coral
description: A soft crochet bracelet with coral beads and a warm brass clasp. Light enough for everyday wear, with the handmade texture Studio D is known for. Stacks easily with other pieces or stands on its own.

name: Thread Friendship Bracelet, Sage
description: A hand-knotted friendship bracelet in sage, cream, and honey-gold threads. Made in the classic chevron pattern, finished with sliding knots so it fits most wrists. A small, lasting gift.

name: Satin Scrunchie Set, Blush
description: A set of three satin scrunchies in blush, cream, and dusty rose. Gentle on hair, with a soft gather that looks finished rather than sporty. Packed together for gifting or everyday rotation.

name: Crochet Daisy Hair Clip
description: A tiny crochet daisy on a gold-tone alligator clip. The petals are stitched in cream with a honey-gold centre, a small handmade accent for buns, braids, or a tucked-behind-the-ear wave.

name: Anniversary Set, Lavender & Vanilla
description: A thoughtful anniversary gift set featuring a pair of hand-poured soy candles in lavender and vanilla, a crochet heart keychain, and a personalizable greeting card. Packaged in a linen-textured box with a dried lavender sprig.
materials: Soy wax candles with cotton wicks

name: Mini Crochet Heart Keychain
description: A plump little crochet heart on a gold-tone key ring. Soft enough to squeeze, sturdy enough for keys, and small enough to tuck into a gift. Stitched in blush pink with a cream edge.

name: Daisy Bloom Keychain
description: A cheerful crochet daisy keychain with a green stem loop. The kind of small handmade piece that makes a bag or set of keys feel like yours. Each flower is stitched by hand, so no two sit quite the same.

name: Mushroom Bag Charm
description: A squat crochet mushroom charm with a coral cap and cream stem. Clips onto tote straps, pouches, and backpacks with a lobster clasp. Playful, compact, and surprisingly sturdy.

name: Star Charm, Honey Gold
description: A five-point crochet star in honey-gold yarn, lightly stuffed so it holds its shape. Finished with a short chain and clasp for bags, zippers, or a set of keys that need a little light.

name: New Baby Welcome Hamper
description: Welcome a new little one with this hand-curated hamper. Includes a tiny crochet bunny, a soft muslin bib, a small crochet rattle, and a congratulations card. Everything is made from baby-safe, natural materials.

name: Tiny Crochet Bunny
description: A palm-sized amigurumi bunny in cream cotton, with embroidered eyes and a blush-stitched nose. Soft enough to sit on a shelf or tuck into a gift. No plastic parts, safe as a keepsake for little ones.

name: Amigurumi Bear Cub
description: A round little bear cub in warm oatmeal yarn, with tiny ears and a honey-gold scarf. Hand-crocheted and firmly stuffed so it sits upright. A companion piece for nurseries, desks, and quiet corners.
